requirement: Transfer supported DOCX primitive shapes into editable HWP5 body objects with verified geometry and formatting mapping, T009 preservation, safe rejection, and save/reopen evidence.

implementation.targetStructure: One editable GSO object owned by HWP5 body Section0.
implementation.mapping: The receiving HWP5 session revalidates the portable envelope and recomputes the DOCX source mapping before insertion. EMU/point dimensions map to HWPUNIT. Supported size, rotation, flips, solid/no-fill, border and description are preserved.
implementation.t009Proof: Only the pinned RHWP output record envelope for the supported primitive subset is admitted. Unknown records/effects, instance ID reuse, invalid UTF-16 description and field/record tampering fail closed. The proof includes positive rectangle, ellipse and line records; Native acceptance exercised an ellipse.
implementation.preservation: Source DOCX bytes and OPC parts remain unchanged. Destination CFB DocInfo and existing BinData remain unchanged. For the accepted HWP5 save, BodyText/Section0 and refreshed PrvImage were the only changed streams; the existing destination picture, BinData/BIN0001.png and unrelated streams were retained.

guardedReleaseBuild.portability: NOT VERIFIED; Nix store runtime dependencies

nativeX11.environment: Linux X11/Xvfb with private D-Bus and IBus Hangul
nativeX11.t009: PASS; saved, synced=true, changedSince=false, findings empty
nativeX11.preservation: Destination DocInfo, existing BinData/BIN0001.png, existing picture and unrelated CFB streams unchanged.
nativeX11.sourceDocxImmutability: PASS; source hash and OPC parts unchanged
nativeX11.freshDocumentSessionReopen: PASS; closed and reopened in a fresh document session within the same application process; transferred ellipse and original picture both selectable

cleanup.result: PASS; complete, proven, filesystemProven, exit 0, no survivors or process errors

limitations: Native acceptance exercised an ellipse only. Focused HWP5 T009 proof includes positive rectangle, ellipse and line record cases.
This is structured-object transfer for the listed inline primitive subset, not full-document format conversion.
Floating objects, other shape types, text boxes, media and unknown source structures remain outside this mapping and fail closed.
The saved HWP5 was reopened in a fresh document session within the same application process; separate application PID reopen was NOT RUN.
The guarded build included the preserved user-owned dirty patches/rhwp/table-calc/evaluator.rs input; committed-root-only artifact reproduction is NOT VERIFIED.
Wayland, Windows, macOS and external Office/Hancom interoperability were NOT RUN. Nix-independent portability is NOT VERIFIED.
